summary: Verified the four-carrier re-fetch chain end-to-end: in-memory tarfile member extraction (no unsquashfs/7z, no privileged mknod anywhere), per-stage sha-mismatch link names and exit codes, 133.4 MiB download / 104 MiB cache budget, and the write footprint. Five findings for the L1, chiefly carrier_fresh_ok's re_scored_pins waiver and census re-derivation from unsquashfs -lln. One disclosure: guard probing fetched the images for real outside the lane; all bytes deleted.
